cases.prompt: Use the google-ads-audit skill. No Google Ads connector is available in this session, so audit only from the four CSV exports from the Google Ads interface for Summit Heating & Cooling (customer ID 555-123-4567, USD, a lead-generation HVAC business in Denver). `campaigns.csv`, `search_keywords.csv` and `search_terms.csv` cover 2026-09-12 to 2026-10-11 (30 days); `conversions.csv` is the conversions summary for the same window. I could not export ads, assets, devices, locations, audiences, placements or negative keyword lists. Write the audit to `reports/google-ads-audit.md` and give me the headline in chat.

assertions.label: wasted spend in window = spend on zero-conversion search terms

criteria: Ad Creative and Targeting are reported as Not assessed, each naming the missing export (ads/assets; devices, locations, audiences or placements), and they are left out of the overall score average
The overall score arithmetic is shown per assessed dimension (start at 10, Critical -4, High -2, Medium -1, Low -0.5) and the average matches the stated overall score
Search - Commercial HVAC is rated Critical for $310.00 spend with zero conversions
Search - Brand is flagged as budget-capped (average daily spend $28.80 against a $30.00 budget, 96%) and treated as a top performer because its CPA ($21.07) is below the account CPA ($58.80)
The 'Contact form submit' lead action counted as Every is flagged with a recommendation to switch counting to One
The keyword 'hvac' with Quality Score 2 is flagged as a very low Quality Score finding
Every fix is a recommendation for the user; the answer does not claim to have changed anything in the account or to have queried a connector
